method.name: CaptureContentIntegritySnapshot_NoSync
method.summary: Capture the GuidReferenceItem graph projection used by canonical content-integrity hashing.
method.remarks: Includes Content, Next, Previous, and UndirectedLinks. UndirectedLinks are treated as an unordered set; encrypted items use the stored encrypted representation.

method.name: CaptureContentMutationMemento_NoSync
method.summary: Capture the reference item's content and graph links for rollback of a rejected content mutation.
method.remarks: The memento restores Content, Next, Previous, and the original UndirectedLinks set reference; DataItemStateSnapshot restores shared protection and integrity state.
method.returns: Memento for the current reference graph payload.

method.name: TryPrepareContentIntegrityState
method.summary: Prepare a content digest only when this reference item has clear-content graph data.
method.param: Receives the current content digest when eligible.
method.returns: True when clear-content graph data is present.

method.name: HasContentIntegrityData_NoSync
method.summary: Determine whether the item has any clear-content graph data for integrity hashing.
method.returns: True when Content, Next, Previous, or at least one UndirectedLinks entry is present.
method.remarks: Does not acquire synchronization; callers must hold the item's data gate.

method.name: RefreshContentIntegrityState_NoSync
method.summary: Refresh or clear the content-integrity hash and update its assertion state.
method.param: Security context used to apply the content assertion state.
method.returns: True when the hash update and assertion-state application both succeed.
method.remarks: Clears the content hash and assertion if either update or assertion application reports failure. Does not acquire synchronization; callers must hold the item's data gate.

method.name: RefreshContentIntegrityStateAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously refresh or clear the content-integrity hash and update its assertion state.
method.param: Security context used to apply the content assertion state.
Token forwarded to the content-hash update.
method.returns: True when the hash update and assertion-state application both succeed.
method.remarks: Clears the content hash and assertion if either update or assertion application reports failure. Does not acquire synchronization; callers must hold the item's data gate. Exceptions that escape the update propagate to the caller.

main.remarks: This Content of this item references the ID field of any other item or tool. Use the Next and Previous fields to build a linked list and/or UndirectedLinks to store a graph.

method.name: op_Inequality
method.returns: True if GuidReferenceItems are not equal.

method.name: SetContent
method.returns: Returns true if Content was set successfully.

method.name: SetNext
method.returns: Returns true if Next was set successfully.

method.name: SetPrevious
method.returns: Returns true if Previous was set successfully.

method.name: SetUndirectedLinks
method.returns: Returns true if UndirectedLinks was set successfully.

method.name: WipeDataInMemoryOnly
method.summary: Securely erases only the in-memory plaintext data fields.
method.returns: True if the data was successfully zeroed; otherwise, false.
method.remarks: Does not affect encrypted data or file-based content.
